subject.title: Bug: Web UI session context not preserved after restart — model can't see history that UI displays

question: For the linked fix path, should a displayed WebChat session suppress idle/daily freshness only for a one-shot restart/page-load restore, or should any visible session id override freshness on ordinary later sends?
rationale: Both choices can preserve the reported conversation context, but they encode different session-reset policy for existing users and cannot be safely inferred from code alone.

options.title: One-shot restore only
options.body: Preserve the restart/page-load continuation while keeping ordinary later stale sends on the existing rollover path.

options.title: Visible session always wins
options.body: Allow the WebChat-visible session id to override idle/daily freshness whenever it matches storage, accepting the reset-policy change explicitly.

options.title: Disclose stale session instead
options.body: Do not auto-continue stale visible sessions; instead show a WebChat recovery/continue choice before sending.

recommendation.title: One-shot restore only
recommendation.body: Preserve the restart/page-load continuation while keeping ordinary later stale sends on the existing rollover path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged reconnect-session work established the current one-shot freshness boundary that the linked fix must preserve or intentionally change.
